snippet.title: Official Demo Trailer (Survival Fantasy VN) - That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes
snippet.description:
That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes and Now I'm Bound to a Multiverse Protector!

A boring Tuesday afternoon turns into a claustrophobic nightmare when massive leviathans suddenly crash through the school grounds. Five friends narrowly survived the massacre, but their nightmare is just beginning.

Because of one desperate act of survival in the biology lab, they are now marked for death by cosmic assassins. Bound to an eccentric, overpowered Multiverse Protector, you must navigate a world that has violently shifted from a grounded survival horror into a high-stakes urban fantasy.

Can you hide your scent? Can you protect your friends? Or will the universe balance its ledger with your lives?

🐍 PLAY THE CHAPTER 1-10 DEMO NOW: https://hudarashi.itch.io

Features:
● Genre-Bending Narrative: Experience a gritty survival thriller that aggressively pivots into a magical multiverse war.
● Choices Matter: The hub system tests your loyalties—who you check on first determines their resolve to survive.
● Unforgiving Lore: The monsters aren't mindless; they are the fundamental forces of reality, and they hold a grudge.

#VisualNovel #VNDemo #SurvivalHorror #AnimeGame #IndieGame #ItchIo
